description: The Firebase apiKey is hardcoded in the source code. This poses a security risk if the repository is shared or exposed.
impact: Potential unauthorized access to Firebase services and data if the key is leaked.

description: Rules allow any authenticated user to read and write all entities, events, and groups. No owner-level isolation is enforced.
impact: Any authenticated user can view or modify data belonging to other users if they discover the IDs.

description: The store handles state, persistence, business logic, and API orchestration in a single 800+ line class.
impact: Increased cognitive load for developers and potential for difficult-to-track side effects as the project grows.

description: Automated voice processing tests are skipped in CI due to timing issues in Playwright.
impact: Reduced confidence in the core voice-first feature without manual verification.
